Who we are

Civil engineers who also build.

Skyline is a consulting civil engineering and development company. The engineers who draw your plan also supervise the pour, so the details on paper are the details on site.

  • Elevations you can see before you buildPhoto-real 3D renders of your front, colours and balconies, agreed before work starts.
  • Structure designed for your plotFootings, columns, beams and slabs sized to your soil, floors and loads.
  • Stage-by-stage site updatesPhotos from the site at every stage, so you always know what has been done and what is next.

What we do

Six services.
One site team.

Hire us for the drawing, the structure, the build, or all of it. The same engineers stay with your project from start to handover.

Design & 3D elevation

Floor plans and photo-real elevation renders, so you see the finished front, colours and balcony details before the first brick is laid.

Structural engineering

Footing, column, beam and slab design by civil engineers, drawn for the soil and load conditions of your plot.

Residential construction

Independent houses and duplexes, built from foundation to handover by one team under one site supervisor.

Shops & mixed-use

Shops with a home above, small offices and apartment buildings, planned for shutters, parking and future floors.

Interiors & finishing

False ceilings, cove lighting, marble and tile work, wardrobes and TV units, finished to the drawing.

Site supervision

Stage-wise inspections, material checks, schedules and photo updates, for owners who live far from the site.

How we work

Five stages,
no surprises.

Every project follows the same order. You approve each stage before the next one begins.

  1. 01

    Consultation & site visit

    We listen to what you need, measure the plot, and check local bylaws and soil conditions before anything is drawn.

    You get: scope and budget range
  2. 02

    Design & 3D elevation

    Floor plans and elevation renders you can review and change. We prepare a bill of quantities before you commit.

    You get: plans, 3D views, estimate
  3. 03

    Structure & approvals

    Structural drawings, material specifications and the drawing set needed for local approvals.

    You get: structural and approval drawings
  4. 04

    Construction & supervision

    Foundation to slab casting under regular supervision, with material checks and photo updates at each stage.

    You get: stage reports with photos
  5. 05

    Finishing & handover

    Plaster, flooring, ceilings, lighting and fittings, then a final inspection before we hand over the keys.

    You get: a finished home and handover checklist
